Tough Claws: Contact moves (punches, bites, most physical moves that touch the target) do 1.3x damage.
Regenerator: Heals 1/3 of its max HP whenever it switches out.
Tinted Lens: Its not-very-effective hits do double damage, so they land as if neutral.
Solid Rock: Super-effective hits against it do 3/4 damage.
Strong Jaw: Biting moves (Crunch, the elemental Fangs, Psychic Fangs, Fishious Rend...) do 1.5x damage.
Sharpness: Slicing moves (Leaf Blade, X-Scissor, Night Slash, Sacred Sword, Psycho Cut...) do 1.5x damage.
Magic Bounce: Reflects status moves and hazards (Toxic, Spikes, Taunt, Stealth Rock...) back at the user.
Magic Guard: Only direct attacks damage it: no hurt from poison, burn, hazards, weather, Life Orb or recoil.
Triage: Healing moves (Recover, Soft-Boiled, draining moves...) get +3 priority, so they go first.
Filter: Super-effective hits against it do 3/4 damage.
Prankster: Status moves get +1 priority (they fail against Dark types).
Technician: Moves of 60 power or less do 1.5x damage.
Sheer Force: Moves with a side effect (a burn chance, a stat drop...) lose it and do 1.3x damage.
Drought: Summons harsh sun for 5 turns on entry: Fire moves 1.5x, Water moves 0.5x.
Punk Rock: Sound moves (Hyper Voice, Boomburst, Bug Buzz...) do 1.3x damage; it takes half damage from them.
Reckless: Moves with recoil (Brave Bird, Flare Blitz, Double-Edge...) do 1.2x damage.
Electric Surge: Sets Electric Terrain for 5 turns on entry: grounded Pokémon's Electric moves 1.3x, and no one grounded can fall asleep.
Stamina: Its Defense rises one stage every time it's hit by an attack.
Grassy Surge: Sets Grassy Terrain for 5 turns on entry: grounded Pokémon's Grass moves 1.3x, everyone grounded heals 1/16 a turn.
Thick Fat: Takes half damage from Fire and Ice moves.
Unaware: Ignores the foe's stat changes when attacking or being attacked.
Toxic Debris: When a physical move hits it, a layer of Toxic Spikes lands on the foe's side.
Psychic Surge: Sets Psychic Terrain for 5 turns on entry: grounded Pokémon's Psychic moves 1.3x, and grounded Pokémon can't be hit by priority moves.
Sand Stream: Summons a sandstorm for 5 turns on entry: chip damage to non-Rock/Ground/Steel types, Rock types +50% Sp. Def.
Mega Launcher: Pulse and aura moves (Water Pulse, Dark Pulse, Dragon Pulse, Aura Sphere...) do 1.5x damage.
Ice Scales: Takes half damage from special moves.
Snow Warning: Summons snow for 5 turns on entry: Ice types +50% Defense, and Blizzard never misses.
Super Luck: Raises its critical-hit chance by one stage.
Fluffy: Takes half damage from contact moves, but double from Fire moves.
Adaptability: Same-type moves get a 2x boost instead of 1.5x.
Pixilate: Normal moves become Fairy moves and do 1.2x damage.
Intimidate: Lowers the foes' Attack one stage when it comes in.
Mold Breaker: Its moves ignore abilities that would stop them (Levitate, Sturdy, Multiscale...).
Unburden: Its Speed doubles once its held item is used up or lost.
Iron Barbs: Attackers that make contact lose 1/8 of their max HP.
Refrigerate: Normal moves become Ice moves and do 1.2x damage.
Cursed Body: 30% chance to disable the move that hit it for 4 turns.
Rough Skin: Attackers that make contact lose 1/8 of their max HP.
Trace: Copies the opponent's ability when it comes in.
Levitate: Immune to Ground moves (and Spikes, Toxic Spikes, terrain).
Bad Dreams: Sleeping foes lose 1/8 of their max HP each turn.
Merciless: Its attacks are always critical hits against poisoned foes.
Skill Link: Multi-hit moves (Bullet Seed, Rock Blast, Pin Missile...) always hit 5 times.
Drizzle: Summons rain for 5 turns on entry: Water moves 1.5x, Fire moves 0.5x.
Speed Boost: Its Speed rises one stage at the end of every turn.
Inner Focus: It can't flinch, and Intimidate doesn't affect it.
Download: On entry, raises Attack or Sp. Atk (whichever the foe's weaker defense calls for) one stage.
No Guard: Every move used by or against it always hits.
Moxie: Its Attack rises one stage each time it knocks out a Pokémon.
Storm Drain: Draws in Water moves: immune to them, and its Sp. Atk rises one stage when hit by one.
Aerilate: Normal moves become Flying moves and do 1.2x damage.
Armor Tail: Opponents can't use priority moves against it or its allies.
Analytic: Its moves do 1.3x damage when it moves last in a turn.
Poison Heal: Heals 1/8 of its max HP each turn while poisoned, instead of losing HP.
Mirror Armor: Bounces stat-lowering effects (Intimidate, Sticky Web, Growl...) back at the user.
Slow Start: Its Attack and Speed are halved for its first 5 turns in battle.
Sap Sipper: Immune to Grass moves; its Attack rises one stage when hit by one.
Queenly Majesty: Opponents can't use priority moves against it or its allies.
Scrappy: Its Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost types; immune to Intimidate.
Neutralizing Gas: While it's in battle, every other Pokémon's ability stops working.
Sand Force: Ground, Rock and Steel moves do 1.3x damage in a sandstorm; immune to sand damage.
Stall: It always moves last within its priority bracket.
Pressure: Moves used against it use 2 PP instead of 1.
Stakeout: Its moves do double damage to a Pokémon that switched in this turn.
Unnerve: Opponents can't eat their Berries while it's in battle.
Wind Rider: Immune to wind moves (Hurricane, Air Cutter...), and its Attack rises when hit by one or when Tailwind starts.
Wind Power: When hit by a wind move, its next Electric move does double damage.
Sturdy: Survives any hit from full HP with 1 HP; immune to one-hit KO moves.
Tera Shell: At full HP, every hit against it is not very effective.
